label: prefill_s128
rationale: AI is below 0.5 R, so the primary plan is MemMode. Scores stay off HBM in both plans. Tile size and extra epilogue fusion are what switch on a custom kernel. This is not a Stage-Stream implementation and not a new attention algorithm. Library SDPA already fuses scores, so the executable epilogue policy is compile_sdpa_chain (timed as always_fuse), including when the analytical primary is ComputeMode. always_unfuse only splits RMSNorm off that library kernel. Re-run the bakeoff before quoting latency for this policy.
